chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to me from Ali ibn Hassan al-Wasiti, from his uncle Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir al-Hashimi, the mawla of Muhammad ibn Ali, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was sitting one day with Ibn al-Hanafiyyah when he said: 'O Muhammad, bring me a vessel with water in it so I may perform ablution for prayer.' Muhammad brought him the water, and he poured water from his right hand into his left hand.
Then he said: 'In the name of Allah, praise be to Allah who made water pure and did not make it impure.'
He said: Then he performed istinja (cleaning the private parts) and said: 'O Allah, protect my private parts, keep them chaste, cover my nakedness, and prohibit the Fire for me.'
Then he rinsed his mouth and said: 'O Allah, grant me my argument/case on the day I meet You, and free my tongue with Your remembrance.'
Then he sniffed water into his nose and said: 'O Allah, do not deprive me of the scent of Paradise, and make me among those who smell its fragrance, its breeze, its blossoms, and its perfume.'
He said: Then he washed his face and said: 'O Allah, whiten my face on the day when faces will turn black, and do not blacken my face on the day when faces will turn white.'
Then he washed his right hand and said: 'O Allah, give me my book in my right hand, and eternity in the Gardens with my left, and reckon me with an easy reckoning.'
Then he washed his left hand and said: 'O Allah, do not give me my book in my left hand, and do not make it tied to my neck, and I seek refuge in You from the severing of the Fire.'
Then he wiped his head and said: 'O Allah, cover me with Your mercy, blessings, and forgiveness.'
He said: Then he wiped his feet and said: 'O Allah, make me steadfast on the Path on the day when feet will slip, and make my effort pleasing to You, O Most Merciful of the merciful.'

Then he raised his head and looked at Muhammad and said: 'O Muhammad, whoever performs ablution like my ablution and says like my saying, Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, creates from every drop an angel who sanctifies it, praises it, and magnifies it. Allah, the Exalted, records for him the reward for that until the Day of Resurrection.'

key_terms.الاسْتِنْجَاء: Cleaning the private parts after relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: What are the specific supplications recited during each step of Imam Ali's ablution?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq details the precise ritual ablution of Imam Ali (a.s.) and his corresponding supplications, highlighting the Shia emphasis on the spiritual efficacy of specific dhikr during wudu. It underscores the concept of 'thawab al-'amal' (reward of action), promising that angels are created from each drop of water to glorify Allah and record rewards until the Day of Judgment, linking physical purity with spiritual accountability.
